safety_verdicts.content: Headache improves when the patient is lying down.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states headache improves when lying down, but no generated fact mentions positional improvement.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Positional improvement (better lying down) can meaningfully affect the headache differential (e.g., orthostatic/CSF pressure-related etiologies vs primary headache) and informs urgency and follow-up advice. Omitting this detail can reduce diagnostic accuracy and delay appropriate escalation if symptoms persist or evolve.
